topic: Tencent Huailai Ruibei Cloud Data Center (腾讯怀来瑞北云数据中心) and the Hebei Chindata Cunrui base (河北秦淮数据存瑞基地), Cunrui town, Huailai: official 2026 location map registered to Esri World Imagery

candidates.name: Tencent Huailai Ruibei Cloud Data Center
Chindata Hebei Cunrui base, Cunrui phases 1-4

source_map.title: 现状及用地分析图 sheet of the 腾讯怀来瑞北云数据中心扩建自用110千伏变电站及线路工程项目建设工程设计方案, attached to the Huailai County Spatial Planning Committee Office pre-approval publicity of 10 August 2026
source_map.content: Imagery panel (north-up) outlining 腾讯怀来瑞北云数据中心范围 (red dashes) south of provincial road S241 (正阳线), the 改扩建范围 (blue dashes) at its south-east corner, and labelling 存瑞中学 (west, with a running track), 河北秦淮数据存瑞基地 (the campus north of S241) and 葫芦套村. Text: the expansion substation lies at the south-east of the Ruibei cloud data centre at 头二营村 and 葫芦套村, Cunrui town; north of S241 the site has 存瑞中学 and 河北秦淮数据存瑞基地; the industrial site of 230,947.53 m2 contains already approved and built existing structures.

pixel_to_lonlat: lon = xmin + (col + 0.5) / width * (xmax - xmin); lat = ymax - (row + 0.5) / height * (ymax - ymin), using the extent returned by the f=json response (identical to the request).

registration.method: Least-squares six-parameter affine from full-resolution sheet pixels to WGS84 lon/lat, five controls read by eye on both images (pure Python, offline).

tencent_ruibei.role: Area centroid of the official red-dashed extent of the Tencent Huailai Ruibei Cloud Data Center, registered to Esri imagery. It falls on the large central data-centre buildings. It is not a surveyed point or a building centre.
tencent_ruibei.area_check: The registered red-dashed extent measures 229,747 m2 against the 230,947.53 m2 industrial site stated on the same sheet (-0.5%).
tencent_ruibei.site_plan_check: The 扩建后总平面图 sheet of the same publicity (local hl-71496-img2.jpg, sha256 7171ced2...6d0) shows parcel 130730004010GB00015 with buildings 1#-8# (丙类厂房) and the 9# 综合楼, the new substation items K-1 to K-9 only inside the blue expansion scope, and the diesel generator sets, buried oil tanks and water tanks marked 已批已建; the Esri image shows the same eight large buildings and the courtyard building.

chindata_cunrui.role: Analyst-selected area centroid of the building block that the official sheet labels 河北秦淮数据存瑞基地, traced on the Esri image. It is not an operator pin, parcel centroid, surveyed point or phase boundary.
chindata_cunrui.label_check: The registered centre of the sheet label 河北秦淮数据存瑞基地 is (115.5653576, 40.4903596), inside the traced block, 81 m north-north-east of the selected point.
chindata_cunrui.chindata_own_record: The 7 June 2023 pre-approval publicity of the 环首都·存瑞云计算产业基地110KV变电站建设项目 (builder 河北秦淮数据有限公司, 4,500.09 m2 public-facility land at 头二营村 and 葫芦套村; local hl-79-46452.html) attaches a location map (local hl-46452-img1.jpg, sha256 c8dad304...d17f) whose red 本期建设范围 box sits north of the same provincial road, east of the school with the running track, at the south-west edge of the campus then under construction. The September 2026 restructuring report lists the same 4,500.09 m2 公用设施用地 for 河北秦淮数据有限公司 at 头二营村 and 葫芦套村.

imagery_observation: The undated Esri image shows the Tencent campus south of S241 (eight large data halls and a courtyard building, with the walled extent matching the red dashes) and the Chindata block north of S241, with the Cunrui middle-school running track to the west and the 葫芦套村 houses to the south-east, as on the official sheet. No physical status is taken from imagery.
